real_event_sampling: Up to 500 eligible HAEDAT events were selected across years using round-robin ordering.
non_event_method: Each synthetic non-event used the same location and calendar month as its matched HAEDAT event, with a year within two years of the event and outside the spatiotemporal exclusion window.
validation_method: Five-fold leave-future-out cross-validation with a 30-day gap.
important_limitation: Synthetic non-events are pseudo-absences and are not confirmed non-bloom observations.
